How to put Caddy in front of a Node app

This guide takes about fifteen minutes and needs a server with a domain pointing at it.

Step 1: Install Caddy

Use your package manager.

Step 2: Write the Caddyfile

Create a file called Caddyfile.

Step 3: Add the site block

example.com {
  reverse_proxy localhost:3000
}

Step 4: Reload the config

Run caddy reload.
